title: File:Kilian jornet Grand raid 2010.JPG
claims: The file shows a runner with a head torch at night at the Colorado place above Saint-Denis, at the end of the 2010 Grand Raid.
The file description identifies the runner as Kilian Jornet and the place as Colorado above Saint-Denis.
The uploader and author is Cecuber, who credits the image as a personal collection.
The file is licensed CC BY-SA 3.0 (Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 3.0).
